name: 37205 · Nashville, TN
findings: ZIP 37205 (Nashville) has 195 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37205 (Nashville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
